summary: Negros Occidental 4th District representative with 59 principal-authored bills. Authored a call for a constitutional convention; co-authored the national minimum wage and fuel-tax relief. Not enough distinct authored evidence. No dimension reaches two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: Few rubric-relevant bills surfaced; the rest of the portfolio was not individually reviewed.
